・As an organization, I can issue a work certificate as a verifiable credentials.
・As a talent, I can receive a work certificate as a verifiable credentials
・As a talent, I can add verified work certificates to my profile.
・As an organization, I can see the talent’s verified work certificates.

Acceptance criteria
Users can go through the “work history as verifiable credentials” feature on the Socious app. They include the following functions:
・As an organization, I can issue a work certificate as a verifiable credentials.
・As a talent, I can receive a work certificate as a verifiable credentials
・As a talent, I can add verified work certificates to my profile.
・As an organization, I can see the talent’s verified work certificates.

・The source code will be available on GitHub (open source)
・These features will be published and available for the community members to go through the flow on the Socious app.
・We will film a walk-through of these functions and publish the video on Youtube so that community members can access it.

If the community reviewer can view the video walk through, the code on Github, and also experience the aforementioned user stories in on the Socious app, then we considered this milestone “accepted”.
